# Files declared "type-checked clean" (Issue #510).
#
# The `typecheck` job in `.github/workflows/tests.yml` runs `pyright` against exactly the
# paths listed here (one per line, repo-root-relative) and fails the build (fail-close) if
# any of them reports a diagnostic. Blank lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored.
#
# Why a declared list instead of the whole repository: `pyright` on the full repo currently
# reports 448 errors (see Issue #510 body, "CI 検査の範囲" — mostly `reportArgumentType` /
# `reportOptionalMemberAccess` / `reportOptionalSubscript` spread across `tests/`,
# `issue_start/`, `archive/` and others). Gating the whole repo today would either fail every
# PR immediately or require silencing hundreds of pre-existing findings, neither of which is
# this issue's scope (see "Out of scope"). Instead, a file only enters this list once it has
# been brought to a clean state, and this CI job's only job is to make sure it *stays* clean
# (this is exactly the gap PR #515 fell through: the fix was correct, but the verification
# used to confirm it — main-context `pyright` run from an isolated worktree's absolute path —
# was silently invalid, and nothing in CI re-checked it before merge).
#
# To extend this list: confirm `pyright <path>` is clean when run with the repository root as
# cwd (running from any other directory can make imports fail to resolve, which produces a
# false "clean" result — see Issue #510's reopen record), then add the path below.

tests/unit/test_pr_merge_classifier.py
